name: Bandit Camp (Wilderness)
accessNote: The Bandit Camp east of the Ruins in the Wilderness (around level 14-20) holds the level 22 and level 130 bandits assigned by Krystilia. The bandits are aggressive to all players, so approach with caution. This is a PvP zone; bring Wilderness-appropriate risk gear. The Slayer task/Bandits location table (pageid 298779) lists the Wilderness Bandit Camp as multi-combat and cannonable (not safespottable).
